operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (m) Establish mechanisms which translate national foreign intelligence objectives and priorities approved by the NSC into specific guidance for the Intelligence Community, resolve conflicts in tasking priority, provide to departments and agencies having information collection capabilities that are not part of the National Foreign Intelligence Program advisory tasking concerning collection of national foreign intelligence, and provide for the development of plans and arrangements for transfer of required collection tasking authority to the Secretary of Defense when directed by the President;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 247561; common-crawl capture 2025-10-17T04:06:15Z; (m)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (n) Develop, with the advice of the program managers and departments and agencies concerned, the consolidated National Foreign Intelligence Program budget, and present it to the President and the Congress;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 247561; common-crawl capture 2025-10-17T04:06:15Z; (n)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (o) Review and approve all requests for reprogramming National Foreign Intelligence Program funds, in accordance with guidelines established by the Office of Management and Budget;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 247561; common-crawl capture 2025-10-17T04:06:15Z; (o)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (p) Monitor National Foreign Intelligence Program implementation, and, as necessary, conduct program and performance audits and evaluations;'

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 247561; common-crawl capture 2025-10-17T04:06:15Z; (p)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (q) Together with the Secretary of Defense, ensure that there is no unnecessary overlap between national foreign intelligence programs and Department of Defense intelligence programs consistent with the requirement to develop competitive analysis, and provide to and obtain from the Secretary of Defense all information necessary for this purpose;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 247561; common-crawl capture 2025-10-17T04:06:15Z; (q)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (r) In accordance with law and relevant procedures approved by the Attorney General under this Order, give the heads of the departments and agencies access to all intelligence, developed by the CIA or the staff elements of the Director of Central Intelligence, relevant to the national intelligence needs of the departments and agencies; and
